name: Pontianak
description: A female spirit often associated with banana trees. Can scream and manage your ex-boyfriend.

name: Pocong
description: A shrouded ghost with its burial cloth remains tied. Provides jump scares and professional hopping.

name: Toyol
description: A small sneaky supernatural being. Talented in stealing money and valuables.

name: Jiangshi
description: Hopping corpse in Qing-era clothing. Suitable for night patrols and guarding treasures.

name: Hungry Ghost
description: A restless spirit driven by insatiable hunger. Can eat a lot. A fantastic mukbang companion.

name: Kuttichathan
description: A mischievous supernatural boy. Can do pranks and sabotages. Great for parties and events.

name: Penanggal
description: Detaches her head from its body at night, flying through the darkness. Specializes in aerial surveillance and rooftop inspections.

name: Bhuta
description: A restless spirit resulting from an unnatural death. Makes any suspiciously peaceful house properly haunted.

name: Brahmarakshasa
description: Enormous and frightening but super intelligent. Can help you with your business and investments.

name: Mohini
description: A fierce female spirit who enchants men. Provides professional dating consultancy.

name: Hantu Tetek
description: A ghost with enormous breasts. Can disorient, trap and suffocate your enemies.
